A rare and almost complete Roman lead rectangular tag, measuring 42mm in length and 31mm in width. This tag was discovered folded in half, it was subsequently opened out, the fold line can still be seen. It has a central circular perforation near to the edge of one of the short sides. Both faces of this tag have incised roman writing on them, one side has clearer writing on three distinct lines…
